name: rosbag2_go2_map_color_benchmark02
description: A rosbag-format dataset intended for evaluating robotic mapping and color/semantic consistency tasks using recorded sensor streams (e.g., cameras, odometry). It provides time-synchronized sensor data for reproducing mapping or color-mapping experiments and assessing mapping quality across runs. The benchmark is suitable for testing sensor-fusion, mapping, and SLAM post-processing algorithms under realistic recorded conditions.
evaluation_method: task_success_rate / IoU for semantic/color mapping and localization_error (RMSE) or trajectory error for pose estimation
general_score_metric: IoU for color/semantic mapping or localization RMSE for pose accuracy
reputation: A datasets-style resource hosted on Hugging Face likely used by a small robotics community for reproducible mapping experiments; not a widely cited standard benchmark.
